title: LEGiON Platforms beta releases Plundur.io in 250+ countries
article: (LEGiON Platforms) - LEGiON Platforms, a 3D technology and web ecosystem company, has announced the global launch of its latest game, Plundur.io. The 3D multiplayer pirate-themed survival game is now available to play in more than 250 countries through web browsers via the link https://plundur.io/. Plundur.io is a unique and thrilling gaming experience that immerses players in the open seas as they take on the role of a pirate. Players must navigate the seas, scavenge for treasure, and battle other players to survive. The game features stunning 3D graphics and multiple game modes, including a free-for-all battle royale mode and a team-based capture the flag mode, allowing players to engage in fast-paced and action-packed battles. This new release marks a significant milestone for LEGiON Platforms, as it is the company's first game to be launched in such a large number of countries. The launch of Plundur.io has been met with excitement from both players and industry experts. Many have praised the game's graphics and immersive gameplay, calling it a "must-play" for fans of pirate-themed games. Plundur.io is now available to play for free in web browsers via the link https://plundur.io/. With its global launch, players from all over the world can now set sail and join the pirate adventure. title: SnowBlast releases for LEGiON Christmas event
article: (LEGiON Platforms) - LEGiON Platforms is excited to announce the release of SnowBlast, a 3D multiplayer snowball fight game, just in time for the Christmas event. SnowBlast features realistic winter environments and physics-based gameplay, making for a truly immersive gaming experience. In addition, the game will have different game modes and customizations options, allowing players to tailor their gameplay experience. SnowBlast is now available to play for free in web browsers and is sure to be a hit for the holidays.

title: CrazyRun.io official soft launch initiates world-wide
article: (LEGiON Platforms) - LEGiON Platforms has launched CrazyRun.io, a free-to-play 3D multiplayer running game. The game offers a variety of levels and characters to unlock, adding an extra layer of replayability. The multiplayer mode allows players to compete against each other in real-time races. CrazyRun.io is now available to play for free in web browsers.

title: BuildSurvival prepares for complete rework
article: (LEGiON Platforms) - LEGiON Platforms is excited to announce that BuildSurvival, its popular 3D building game, is being reworked for an improved gaming experience. LEGiON Platforms is looking forward to releasing the reworked version of BuildSurvival and can't wait for players to experience the new features and improvements.
